llm_response.reason: The site mimics the appearance and branding of Aerie/American Eagle without any official affiliation or credible business identification. It lacks legitimate company contact details, displays an excessive variety of products typically not found together, and shows standard scam signaling text about 'secure shopping' and 'free shipping'. No evidence of a real business or owner exists, and the site uses a suspicious, brand-disconnected domain name. These align with the common characteristics of fake online shopping scams.
